sample_unit: cases (two cohorts, size not reported in abstract)

links.outcome: Confidence and verifiability of LLM+RAG differential diagnosis outputs on uncommon presentations
links.effect: LLM+RAG pipeline produced confident outputs that were frequently unverifiable and resistant to clinician interrogation; no numbers in abstract.
links.quote: We evaluate an LLM+rare-disease-RAG pipeline across two cohorts and show that the paradigm produces confident outputs that are frequently unverifiable and systematically resistant to clinician interrogation.

links.outcome: Traceability and verifiability of LLM+RAG diagnostic outputs by clinicians
links.effect: Outputs were frequently unverifiable and resistant to clinician interrogation; no numbers in abstract.
links.quote: We evaluate an LLM+rare-disease-RAG pipeline across two cohorts and show that the paradigm produces confident outputs that are frequently unverifiable and systematically resistant to clinician interrogation.

unlisted_practices: neuro-symbolic pipeline with ternary symptom encoding and contradiction detection
offline deployment on consumer hardware for low-resource settings

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM+RAG differential diagnosis system on clinical cohorts and proposes a neuro-symbolic design framework with guardrail components (e.g., audit strings, contradiction detection, override), but evaluates system/architecture design rather than an operational deployment practice comparison.
